affected.note: Up to 111,991 records of patients and COVID-19 vaccine recipients (including medical history and treatment data) and 715 staff records.

summary.en: Yasue Hospital in Gifu City suffered a cyberattack on 2022-05-27 that halted its electronic medical record and other systems, which were restored from backups the next day. A forensic investigation found that up to 111,991 patient and vaccine recipient records and 715 staff records may have been leaked.
summary.ja: 岐阜市の安江病院は、2022年5月27日にサイバー攻撃を受け、電子カルテなどのシステムが停止し、翌日バックアップから復旧した。調査の結果、患者や新型コロナワクチン被接種者の情報最大11万1,991件と職員情報715件が流出した可能性があると判明した。
